mode: Read-only reconciliation of completed local artifacts; no strategy rerun, PostgreSQL mutation or real order
checks: Independently recomputed every base-trade brokerage, combined exchange/IPFT, SEBI, GST, STT, stamp and total fee component
Recomputed 10bps adverse entry/exit fills, gross and net P&L, modeled slippage attribution and trade equity
Verified positive integer shares, entry cash collateral, decision-volume cap and entry risk-room constraints
Verified next-open entries within 09:30-11:30, no overlapping positions, no same-stock daily reentry and at most three entries per day
Reconciled daily and terminal cash and independently recomputed all 120 base summary statistics from trade/equity CSVs
Reconciled all 60 reported stress-summary rows to stress.csv; stress trade ledgers are not exported and were not independently recomputed
Reconciled all descriptive event counts and rates for full and chronological periods, exclusions, ambiguity counts, target/reversal levels and event identifiers
Verified current frozen code, runner, plan and acquisition file hashes against the research manifest

volume_gate_ablation.scope: Observed simulated executions only; not a population claim about volume filters
volume_gate_ablation.long_only_both_stops: Exactly identical full-period and development trade ledgers after excluding strategy ID
volume_gate_ablation.long_short_diagnostics: Different ledgers for both stops, consistent with distinct signal mechanisms
volume_gate_ablation.candidate_rejection_reason_audit: Not performed; no reason is assigned to the identical long-only executions

fixed_path_cost_attribution.interpretation: Attribution for the same fixed entries and quantities, not a separately rerun zero-cost strategy

assessment.conclusion: No tested configuration qualifies for paper-bot selection under the frozen rule

limits: Ledger rows span dependent strategy variants and are not independent observations
Arithmetic consistency does not certify historical tradability, fills, depth, price bands, short eligibility or universal data coverage
The audit does not remove the cohort, historical fee-plan, corporate-action, five-minute execution or pseudo-out-of-sample limitations disclosed in the report
